description: Deals from the brand's HubSpot created in the window (default the last 90 days): count and amount by stage (labels resolved through the deal pipelines, closed-won recognised from the stage's own metadata), by original source, BY CAMPAIGN (source -> platform -> campaign from HubSpot's Original Source drill-downs, so PAID_SOCIAL splits into the actual campaigns), BY OWNER (the sales rep holding each deal, by name), a monthly created / closed-won series, and totals. Capped at 2,000 deals and says so. Read-only, free. Needs HubSpot connected.
name: hubspot_deals_report
title: HubSpot deals report
